description:
A world-class connection design software for concrete anchoring

DEWALT DESIGN ASSIST™ (DDA) is a no cost/no fee state-of-the-art structural design software that streamlines, automates, and optimizes your concrete anchoring design process. With multiple design standards to choose from, a comprehensive library of anchors, numerous reporting options, and a wide range of design tools, simplify your design process with DEWALT Design Assist.
DEWALT DESIGN ASSIST
Bug Fixes and Enhancements Version: 1.7.10.0
- Power-Stud+ SD4 and Power-Stud+ SD6 data improvement (ACI & CSA)
  - Additional embedment depths in concrete and top of concrete-filled steel deck
  - New design information in the soffit of concrete-filled steel deck
  - Improved design information
- Addition of Made in USA Power-Stud+ SD4 and Power-Stud+ SD6 (ACI)
- Power-Stud+ SD2 data improvement (ACI & CSA)
  - Additional embedment depth
- Power-Stud+ SD1 and Power-Stud+ SD1 USA data improvement (ACI & CSA)
  - Additional embedment depths in concrete and top of concrete-filled steel deck
- Approval report updates: ESR-2502, ESR-2582, ESR-2818, ESR-3068, ESR-3298, ESR-3576, ESR-4027, ESR-4810, ESR-5144, ETA-16/0905
- General bug fixes to improve overall software stability and performance
- Database updates
